mapper.sql: d.dev_id AS "id",d.mng_no AS "managementNo",d.dev_nm AS "name",d.emp_type_cd AS "employeeType", d.blng_clnt_id AS "companyId",d.grade_cd AS "gradeCode",d.job_cd AS "jobCode",d.sub_job_cd AS "subJobCode", d.jbps_cd AS "positionCode",d.drct_cls_cd AS "directClass",d.part_id AS "partId",d.jncmp_dt AS "hireDate", d.retire_dt AS "retireDate",d.work_stat_cd AS "status",d.home_area_cd AS "homeAreaCode",d.home_addr AS "homeAddress", d.telno AS "phone",d.use_yn AS "useYn",d.reg_user_id AS "regUserId",d.reg_dttm AS "regDttm", d.mod_user_id AS "modUserId",d.mod_dttm AS "modDttm"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_hr_dev d WHERE d.dev_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT dev_id AS "devId",aply_bgn_ym AS "effectiveMonth",aply_end_ym AS "endMonth",mon_uprc AS "monthlyRate", mon_pay_amt AS "monthlyPay",reg_user_id AS "regUserId",reg_dttm AS "regDttm",mod_user_id AS "modUserId",mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_hr_dev_prc WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym FOR UPDATE

SELECT dev_id AS "devId",skill_nm AS "name",sort_ord AS "sortOrder",reg_user_id AS "regUserId",reg_dttm AS "regDttm", mod_user_id AS "modUserId",mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_hr_dev_skill WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY skill_nm FOR UPDATE

SELECT dev_id AS "devId",stat_sn AS "sn",work_stat_cd AS "state",bgn_dt AS "startDate",end_dt AS "endDate", stat_rsn AS "reason",close_leave_sn AS "closeLeaveSn",orgnl_leave_end_dt AS "originalLeaveEndDate", reg_user_id AS "regUserId",reg_dttm AS "regDttm",mod_user_id AS "modUserId",mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_hr_dev_stat WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY stat_sn FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM tb_hr_dev d LEFT JOIN tb_bs_clnt c ON c.clnt_id=d.blng_clnt_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code g ON g.code_grp_id='GRADE' AND g.code=d.grade_cd LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code j ON j.code_grp_id='JOB' AND j.code=d.job_cd LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT max(input_end_dt) withdrawal FROM tb_pj_asgn a WHERE a.dev_id=d.dev_id AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND a.input_bgn_dt<=#{today} AND a.input_end_dt>=#{today}) a ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT mon_uprc FROM tb_hr_dev_prc p WHERE p.dev_id=d.dev_id AND p.aply_bgn_ym<=to_char(#{today}::date,'YYYYMM') AND (p.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR p.aply_end_ym>=to_char(#{today}::date,'YYYYMM')) ORDER BY p.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) p ON true
AND d.emp_type_cd=#{employeeType} AND d.job_cd=#{jobCode} AND d.drct_cls_cd=#{directClass} AND d.work_stat_cd=#{workStatus} AND d.use_yn='Y' AND (strpos(d.dev_nm,#{q})>0 OR strpos(d.mng_no,#{q})>0)
ORDER BY c.clnt_nmd.emp_type_cd g.code_nmj.code_nm d.work_stat_cda.withdrawal p.mon_uprcd.dev_nm DESC ASC NULLS LAST, d.mng_no ASC,d.dev_id ASC
SELECT dev_id FROM tb_hr_dev ORDER BY dev_id

SELECT CASE WHEN d.retire_dt<#{today} THEN 'RETIRE' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_hr_dev_stat s WHERE s.dev_id=d.dev_id AND s.work_stat_cd='LEAVE' AND s.bgn_dt<=#{today} AND (s.end_dt IS NULL OR s.end_dt>=#{today})) THEN 'LEAVE' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_pj_asgn a WHERE a.dev_id=d.dev_id AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND a.input_bgn_dt<=#{today} AND a.input_end_dt>=#{today}) THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT max(a.input_end_dt) FROM tb_pj_asgn a WHERE a.dev_id=d.dev_id AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND a.input_bgn_dt<=#{today} AND a.input_end_dt>=#{today})<=#{threshold} THEN 'WTHDR' ELSE 'INPUT' END ELSE 'IDLE' END FROM tb_hr_dev d WHERE d.dev_id=#{id}

SELECT p.proj_id AS "id",p.proj_nm AS "name",a.input_bgn_dt AS "startDate",a.input_end_dt AS "endDate" FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=a.proj_id WHERE a.dev_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND a.input_end_dt>=#{today} ORDER BY a.input_bgn_dt DESC,a.asgn_id
SELECT count(*) FROM tb_pj_asgn WHERE dev_id=#{id}
SELECT count(*) FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id='JOB' AND code=#{code} AND use_yn='Y' AND del_yn='N'
